scopeNote: Burgers, fried chicken and pizza by the slice that people praise on Phuket (Patong, Kata and Karon, Rawai and Nai Harn, Phuket Town and Koh Kaew, Surin and Si Sunthon), Koh Phangan and Bangkok, plus 12 chain outlets near the villas, Phuket Town, the airport, Thong Sala and central Bangkok; halal places left out.

basics.title: Fast food in Thailand
basics.text: KFC is the biggest chain (more than 700 outlets), followed by McDonald's, Burger King, Thailand's own The Pizza Company, Pizza Hut, Domino's, Subway and Texas Chicken; Shake Shack is in Bangkok only, and we found no Five Guys in Thailand. The Thai menus add rice bowls with spicy or kaprao chicken, McDonald's pork burgers (Samurai Pork Burger 109 THB), Hat Yai-style and tom yum fried chicken and pork congee at Burger King, and corn or pineapple pies. Most mall outlets keep mall hours (about 10:00-22:00); drive-thru branches and several Patong, Khao San and Sukhumvit outlets are open 24 hours.

basics.title: Delivery, 7-Eleven and what a meal costs
basics.text: Grab (GrabFood) and LINE MAN deliver from the chains and from most burger shops in this list; the chains also take orders on their own numbers: McDonald's 1711, KFC 1150, The Pizza Company 1112. At any hour, 7-Eleven heats a ham and cheese toastie for about 30-45 THB. In 2026 a chain meal costs about 150-250 THB (a Big Mac set was 220 THB in late 2024, and Numbeo puts a fast-food meal in Bangkok at about 250 THB in Oct 2026), while a burger at a craft burger shop costs 250-600 THB.
